text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 region. GeoDNS resolution errors flagged (Cloudflare resolver group), Route53 failover not serving expected traffic. Pager triggered for oncall: tara.

tara: ack — I'm looking. Which customers impacted? any error samples?

mitra: I'm seeing a sudden spike in DNS NXDOMAIN/servfail from our health checks to the eu edge pool starting 1957654200. Cloudflare resolver errors ~80% for queries to geo.example.com. Route53 health checks still passing but origin answers look stale (old IPs).

raj: adding context: Cloudflare status page shows "partial outage affecting DNS resolver" in EU region. Could be resolver side rate limiting or EDNS buffer issues.

samir: customer reports: "api requests timed out, 502s" from EU users, but US still fine. tracking support tickets: #2342, #2347, #2350 (EU customers).

jess: monitoring: 5xx rate for eu-west-1 from 0.3% -> 12% in ~5m. Latency also up ~150ms on successful responses.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook link: https://intra/runbooks/geodns-resolver-deg. Recommended quick mitigations: 1) lower GeoDNS TTL to 30s 2) shift weight to Route53 fallback 3) add public resolver overrides to edge config.

tara: executing mitigations now. First: lower TTL on geo records to 30s. I'll change TTL for api.geo -> 30.

raj: I'm updating GeoDNS pool weights to reduce dependency on Cloudflare resolver group. Pushing route: prefer route53 pool (weight -> 80) and set failover threshold to 10% packet loss.

mitra: I'm pushing temporary resolver overrides in edge config: prefer 1.1.1.1 and 9.9.9.9 for DNS queries originating from our eu-build infra. Applying now.

samir: posting short status to customers saying we're investigating DNS resolver errors affecting EU traffic. Minimal wording, no root cause yet.

jess: TTL change confirmed at 1957654350 (propagation to GeoDNS control plane). Watch metrics for > TTL window (30s) to see reroute.

incident-bot: Note: Route53 failover automation did not trigger because health-check window shows intermittent passing. Manual failover recommended if errors persist.

raj: manual failover executed at 1957654385 — switching primary to route53-backed pool. Also invalidated local resolver caches by bumping serial.

mitra: after failover, I'm seeing resolution success rates climb from 20% -> 85% for queries to geo.example.com within 2 TTL cycles. 5xx rate dropping to ~3% now.

tara: continuing to monitor. Can we keep reduced TTL for at least 1 hour to ensure clients pick up new records?

raj: agreed. Will hold for 60m. Also filed a ticket with Cloudflare support with packet captures and query traces.

samir: coordinating support responses to impacted customers. Offering temporary workaround: set client-side resolver to 1.1.1.1 or 9.9.9.9 if still suffering.

jess: alerting: no new user-facing errors in last 10m, backend requests to eu edge normalizing.

ops-runbook-bot: checklist: mitigation applied (TTL lowered, pool weight changed, resolver overrides added), monitoring stable for 10m. Suggest handoff when ready.

mitra: I'm going to hand over to raj for continued observation and post-mortem. My shift ends soon.

tara: thanks mitra. raj, you taking over?

raj: taking over for next 60m. I'll keep watch on DNS query success, Route53 health-checks, and 5xx trend. If anything regresses I'll escalate to network infra.

samir: posting interim status to customers: "Mitigation applied: GeoDNS traffic routed to Route53 fallback and resolver overrides added. We continue to monitor for full recovery. Support is engaged."

jess: note for postmortem: confirm why Route53 failover automation didn't flip earlier (health-check config / sensitivity), verify Cloudflare resolver incident scope, and evaluate adding passive detection for resolver-side failures.

raj: filing incident ticket and assigning P0 postmortem owner. Link: https://intra/incidents/1957654321-pm.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Metrics stable for 30m, 5xx back to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated at 1957655040. Please add timeline notes if you did additional actions.

tara: closing the pager. Good job everyone.

mitra: added notes: Cloudflare reported "degraded DNS resolution in EU due to configuration push causing recursive resolver overload" — they rolled a fix at 1957654900. We'll include their status in the PM.

raj: final action items: 1) update Route53 health-check sensitivity 2) add a passive GeoDNS resolver failure detector 3) review GeoDNS TTL default during incidents. Assignments in ticket.

samir: I'll draft customer post-incident note for EU customers.

jess: leaving a short log of exact commands used for handoff (for oncall playbooks):
```
# lowered ttl
geoctl update-record --name api.geo --ttl 30 --zone global
# change weight
geoctl set-pool-weight --pool cloudflare-eu --weight 20 --pool route53-eu --weight 80
# resolver override
edgectl config set dns_prefer 1.1.1.1,9.9.9.9 --region eu
```

ops-runbook-bot: If postmortem created, please tag with severity: S2 and include customer impact summary.

raj: noted. I'll publish PM in next 24h. Thanks all.
